scenes.title: Mansa Musa's Golden Reign
scenes.description: Part 1 of the historical narrative about the rise of the mali empire under mansa musa
scenes.narration: In 1324, a West African king set out on a pilgrimage so lavish it literally crashed the economy of Cairo. Mansa Musa, ruler of the Mali Empire, traveled with a caravan of sixty thousand men. They carried tons of raw gold, distributing so much wealth that the price of precious metal plummeted for a decade. Under his iron-willed leadership, Mali became the world’s leading producer of gold and salt. Musa transformed Timbuktu into a global beacon of intellect and faith.

scenes.description: Part 2 of the historical narrative about the rise of the mali empire under mansa musa
scenes.narration: He commissioned grand mosques and massive libraries that drew scholars from across the Islamic world. His empire stretched across thousands of miles, controlling vital trans-Saharan trade routes. By the time he returned to Niani, his legend had already reached the maps of Europe. Mansa Musa remains history’s wealthiest individual, a ruler who built an empire on more than just gold.
